For years the expansion of the universe looked like it was speeding up at a steady rate. The latest observations say otherwise, and one physicist thinks the explanation has been hiding in quantum mechanics all along. And if that holds, we are looking at gravity revealing its quantum nature for the first time. Let's take a look.
